en: Black‑and‑white image showing a quiet tree‑lined path along the edge of a lake or pond. A wooden bench sits on the left, slightly sunk into the embankment. On the right, across the water, stands a tall classical column monument with a statue on top and a stepped base, reflected in the still surface of the water. The scene looks like a landscaped park or garden; there is no visible text or caption on the image.
